title: Jesus... My Brother Texted Back After Two Years

bible.text: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my brother texted back after two years of silence. Why am I so scared to be happy about it?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It just said "hey, you free Sunday?" Three words. I have read it about forty times and I still do not know what to feel.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are afraid to be happy about it, in case it does not hold.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if I show up and we just argue about the same thing all over again?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then you will have argued face to face instead of across two years of silence. That is already different.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I rehearsed what I would say to him for so long. Now my head is completely empty.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Good. The speech was for winning. Sunday is not for winning.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Esau had every reason prepared to hate his brother. He ran anyway. Let your brother see you walking toward him, not waiting with your arms folded.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Is there someone you stopped speaking to? 🙏 Three words can start the walk back.
